posts.author: Caimcin
posts.body:
I've never done this before, but today I got inspired and i spent like 6 hours editing some stuff from Rpg Maker XP to fit in with the MV/MZ style. This is a strange Frankenstein of XP assets scaled to 48x48 and edited with MV graphics on top. I spent a lot of time doing this, and I can tell myself it's not perfect, but I'm happy enough with how it came out to share over here.
XP Forest Town House
(with MV wood)
XP Farm House
(with MV stone and thatch)
XP Town Clutter
(with MV well)
I hope you like this and find it useful! If people like it I might put myself to do some more.
You can use this in any Rpg Maker game, commercial or not!
You must own both Rpg Maker XP and MV in order to use it.
Credit is appreciated but not necessary (credit Caimcin)
